description: This file defines theme-related types, constants, and functions for managing UI themes in a web application, including default, dark, and light themes, as well as theme setting and loading mechanisms.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets the current theme, updates user settings, and applies CSS variables to document root.

methods.name: setMattermostTheme
methods.description: Converts a Mattermost theme object into internal theme format and applies CSS variables.

methods.name: loadTheme
methods.description: Loads theme from user settings and applies it.

methods.name: initThemes
methods.description: Initializes theme settings and listens for system color scheme changes.

methods.name: getSelectBaseStyle
methods.description: Returns custom styles for select dropdown components.

methods.name: getActiveThemeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the currently active theme.
